page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance configured with 64 vCPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, this instance features 64 physical cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. The CPU allocation is dedicated, ensuring consistent compute resources without virtualization-induced resource sharing. It operates on the KVM hypervisor.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for persistent data. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 30 Gbps, which supports high-throughput networking tasks. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offer a predictable resource density for enterprise workloads, though the lack of bundled local storage and GPUs represents a tradeoff for storage-intensive or accelerated computing tasks.

The ecs.g5ne.16xlarge is suited for general-purpose enterprise applications, web serving, application servers, and moderate database workloads that require dedicated CPU performance and high network throughput but do not demand local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
